input.command:
python -c $'import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
out = Path("out")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
q = """SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, SUM(COALESCE(number_of_pedestrians_killed, 0))::BIGINT AS pedestrians_killed FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet') WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year"""
df = duckdb.sql(q).df()
df = pd.DataFrame({"year": range(2013, 2026)}).merge(df, on="year", how="left").fillna({"pedestrians_killed": 0})
df["pedestrians_killed"] = df["pedestrians_killed"].astype(int)
df.to_csv(out / "values.csv", index=False)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
ax.bar(df["year"].astype(str), df["pedestrians_killed"], color="#3478a8", width=0.72)
ax.set_title("Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes, 2013–2025")
ax.set_xlabel("Year")
ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed")
ax.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.35)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
ax.bar_label(ax.containers[0], padding=3, fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(out / "initial.png", dpi=180)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nSaved out/initial.png and out/values.csv")'
